notes.title: Update 1.04 Released
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Just a small update today regarding a few issues that us and other players have picked up on. See changes below:

1) Fixed a semi game breaking bug where player could continue after having missed the flashlight, thus resulting in lack of visibility through the remained of the game.
2) Changed level 10 ceiling so it all has the same colour and tone.
3) Changed the dead zone to controllers to stop player moving automatically.

More to follow.

Thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Game Released and Final Update 1.04
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today marks a good day; we have finally made it to the end of the development of the game. 

We would like to thank all persons who have contributed to the development in the game, no matter how small.  And would like to extend our warmest thanks to all the patient people who has gave us feedback during the development of the game.

That said, we will continue to support this game for some time, releasing updates as the days and weeks past, if and when bugs are reported. 

Please find the final update notes for release:

1)	Fixed an overlay texture floating in the air during level 10.
2)	Changed the dead zone of controllers so the player no longer walks right automatically.
3)	Fixed an issue where some monsters would not walk correctly, nor play sound.
4)	Modified the second ending.
5)	Fixed an issue where the gate puzzle would not unlock.
6)	Added two more music tracks.
7)	Fixed spelling and grammatical errors.
8)	General lighting optimization.

Once again, thank you to all those who has aided this games development, and as always, any issues, please let us know in the community threads.

Many thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Update 1.02 - Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Due to issues with the previous update 0.95, we have taken those changes and merged them to to this 1.02 update.

Please find below change notes for this update, and for the previous 0.95 update.

Update 0.95:
a) 10 new levels added
b) Story of the game can now be completed (still not 100% finished)
c) Addition of some story related voice work added
d) Subtitles option added to menu settings.
e) Optimisation and general tweaks to game world.

Update 1.02:
a) Implemented full game-pad mechanics.
b) Improved loading times.
c) Added option to skip intro cut-scenes.
c) Bug fixes, and general optimisation.

As always, if you find any issues, please let us know in the community threads, so we can get them fixed :)

Thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Regarding Update 0.95
notes.content:
Hi eveyone,

We regret to inform you that there appears to be an issue in the new update where the game crashes on loading screen. 

Therefore, because of this, we have decided to roll back to a previous version of the game 0.86. 

We are currently working on a fix and hopefully will get thing working in the next day or two.

Please accept our deepest apologies once more.

(good thing its in Early Access...)

Thanks

Deceptive Games
